tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Page background and night sky on every screen. All light text tokens are checked against it (WCAG AA).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tiles and panels on the sky: mode-choice tiles, toast, menu, inactive toggle track.

tokens.name: surface-error
tokens.usage: Background of the content-error box only.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty progress track and the inactive toggle area.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on sky (13.3:1) and surface (10.8:1). Headings, exercise names, celebration titles.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body text on surface (7.6:1) and surface-error (8.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on sky (6.9:1) and surface (5.6:1): descriptions, metadata, inactive toggle labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Small labels and quiet notes on sky (5.4:1). Do not use on surface for body text.

tokens.name: moonlight
tokens.usage: Interface colour: today's window, primary buttons, menu button icon, back links. The brightest element on the calendar. Text on sky 10.9:1.

tokens.name: on-moonlight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a moonlight fill (10.9:1).

tokens.name: clementine
tokens.usage: Moderate mode accent only: badge, in-routine buttons, reps, progress dots. Text on sky 8.0:1, on surface 6.5:1.

tokens.name: on-clementine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a clementine fill (8.8:1).

tokens.name: clementine-tint
tokens.usage: Image area behind Santa on Moderate exercise cards.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Recovery mode accent only: badge, in-routine buttons, durations, progress dots. Text on sky 8.6:1, on surface 7.0:1.

tokens.name: on-lavender
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lavender fill (9.1:1).

tokens.name: lavender-tint
tokens.usage: Image area behind Santa on Recovery exercise cards.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Done: outline and check of completed windows, progress of days. Check on sage-deep 4.1:1 (icon).

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Fill of completed windows.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Door 24 only: outline, star, halo. Star on brass-deep 6.8:1.

tokens.name: brass-deep
tokens.usage: Fill of window 24.

tokens.name: candle
tokens.usage: Celebration only: windows lighting up in the all-24 finale. Never in everyday UI.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Content errors only: icon, title and frame of the error box (5.6:1 on surface-error). Never on buttons.

tokens.name: facade
tokens.usage: Wall of the calendar house and the chimney.

tokens.name: roof
tokens.usage: Roof of the calendar house, slightly lighter than sky so it reads against the night.

tokens.name: neighbour-1
tokens.usage: Left neighbour silhouette (stepped gable). Barely lighter than sky on purpose.

tokens.name: neighbour-2
tokens.usage: Right neighbour silhouette (curved gable).

tokens.name: neighbour-window
tokens.usage: Dark windows of the neighbour houses.

tokens.name: neighbour-window-lit
tokens.usage: The one faintly lit neighbour window.

tokens.name: window-locked
tokens.usage: Fill of a locked window (future day).

tokens.name: window-locked-frame
tokens.usage: Frame of a locked window. Subtle on purpose (1.5:1 vs facade); the number carries the meaning.

tokens.name: window-locked-ink
tokens.usage: Number in a locked window (5.1:1 on window-locked).

tokens.name: window-missed
tokens.usage: Fill of a missed window (past day, not done). Number in moonlight (6.0:1).

tokens.name: window-missed-frame
tokens.usage: Frame of a missed window (2.9:1 vs facade).

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Snow bank at the bottom of the calendar ("shadow snow"). Dimmed so today's window stays brightest. Text on it: sky (5.9:1).

tokens.name: snow-cap
tokens.usage: Snow on roofs, chimney cap and the sills of done windows.

tokens.name: smoke
tokens.usage: Chimney smoke wisp, drawn at about 35% opacity.

tokens.name: dot-inactive
tokens.usage: Upcoming progress dots. Subtle on purpose; the "3 / 5" text carries the count.

tokens.name: santa-red
tokens.usage: Illustration only: Santa's suit and hat (day 24 only). Red is never a UI colour except the error token.

tokens.name: santa-berry
tokens.usage: Illustration only: Santa's trousers, suit shading.

tokens.name: elf-fir
tokens.usage: Illustration only: elf body, arms and pointy hat (bauble style) and the stick-figure lines. Same for both elves.

tokens.name: elf-fir-deep
tokens.usage: Illustration only: elf legs, belt and curled shoes; the far-side limb in side views.

tokens.name: elf-moderate
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the Moderate elf's scarf/collar and hat band. A deeper clementine so it doesn't blend into skin; the UI keeps clementine.

tokens.name: elf-recovery
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the Recovery elf's scarf/collar and hat band. A deeper lavender for balance with elf-moderate; the UI keeps lavender.

tokens.name: character-skin
tokens.usage: Illustration only: faces, hands and pointy ears of elves and Santa.

tokens.name: character-cheek
tokens.usage: Illustration only: rosy cheeks, drawn at about 80% opacity.

tokens.name: character-nose
tokens.usage: Illustration only: elf noses (Santa: #c9705f).

tokens.name: character-white
tokens.usage: Illustration only: Santa's beard, mittens, hat brim and pompom.

tokens.name: character-ink
tokens.usage: Illustration only: eyes, mouths, Santa's boots, stick-figure details.

tokens.name: character-bell
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the bell on the elves' hats and Santa's belt buckle.

tokens.name: image-neutral
tokens.usage: Image area behind the waiting elves on the mode-choice screen (nothing picked yet), so the green elves read.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Feet hip-width, sit back, stand tall. Breathe steadily.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Reps and durations, in the mode colour.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status line, badges, menu items, metadata.

styles.name: window-number
styles.usage: Day number inside a calendar window.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between windows (horizontal), badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between windows (vertical), toast and menu padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen edge padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections on a card or screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large separations, celebration layouts.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Calendar windows (the doors).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Toast, notices, image areas inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Mode-choice tiles, menu, cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, toggle, menu button.

tokens.name: halo-today
tokens.usage: Soft ring around today's window. The only lit-up window.

tokens.name: halo-brass
tokens.usage: Soft ring around window 24.

tokens.name: menu-shadow
tokens.usage: Opened menu panel only.
